title: Creamy Chicken Stew
description: A rich and creamy keto stew made with tender chicken and velvety sauce.
instructions: Heat butter in a large skillet over medium-high heat.
Add the chicken and cook until browned, about 5 minutes.
Remove the chicken from the skillet and set aside.
Add the stew meat and cook until browned, about 5 minutes.
Add the mushrooms, onion, and garlic to the skillet and cook until the vegetables are tender.
Add the velvety sauce to the skillet and stir to combine.
Return the chicken to the skillet and stir to coat with the sauce.
Season with salt and pepper to taste.
Simmer the stew over low heat for 10-15 minutes, or until the chicken is cooked through.
Serve hot, garnished with chopped fresh herbs if desired.
